name: Zimbabwean Chicken and Vegetable Soup
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 cups canned diced tomatoes, with juices
¼ tsp crushed red pepper flakes, or more to taste
1 cup chopped cooked chicken, or to taste

steps: Heat the olive oil in the pot over medium heat. Add the onion, and sauté for about 5 minutes until translucent.
Stir ½ cup of the vegetable stock and the peanut butter into the onions until the mixture looks smooth.
Stir in the remaining vegetable stock, diced tomatoes with their liquid, and crushed red pepper flakes; simmer for 30 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in the cabbage, sweet potato, carrot, and turnip. Simmer, stirring, until the vegetables become soft (about 30 minutes).
Stir in the okra and chicken, and simmer for about 30 additional minutes.

culture.text: Soup is a primarily liquid food, generally served warm or hot – though it is sometimes served chilled – made by cooking or otherwise combining meat or vegetables with stock, milk, or water. According to The Oxford Companion to Food, soup is the main generic term for liquid savoury dishes; others include broth, bisque, consommé, potage and many more.
